'''Avilatan's Rest''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] built in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]-held [[Fort Garnik]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]. It was open during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and served a large number of [[Republic soldier]]s and [[Mantellian Trooper]]s who were stationed in Garnik to fight in the [[Separatist War]].

The cantina consisted of one large main room with a single raised side room accessible by a ramp. It contained a [[Jukebox/Legends|jukebox]] and a two separate bars which were staffed by at least two [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'leks]], one of whom, named [[Ryn (individual)|Ryn]], sold jukebox tokens, and a pair of [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droids]]. Republic ethics officer [[Drage]] was known to drink there.

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
An individual visited Ethics Officer Drage while he was there to report the existence of a minefield obstacle course set up by [[Corporal/Legends|Corporal]] [[Dregg (Human)|Dregg]] and [[Ensign/Legends|Ensign]] [[Ta (individual)|Ta]].
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Avilatan's Rest is a location found in the [[Star Wars video games#Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. The cantina is similar to many others in the game in that it is an area in which players can speak to their companion characters or buy [[Jukebox/Legends|jukebox]] tokens to listen to music.
